questions.stem_text: All of the following statements about gerrymandering are true EXCEPT that it

options.B: can divide like-minded voters into several districts to reduce their influence
options.C: has been allowed by the Supreme Court in some instances
options.D: increases the control voters have over their elected officials

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - increases the control voters have over their elected officials

questions.stem_text:
Which of the following did not emerge as a trend of the defence trade in the 20 th
century?

options.A: The arms trade shifts from being a private to a government controlled enterprise.
options.B: An increase in the defence trade.
options.C: A decrease in the arms trade.
options.D: A growth in the number and variety of weapons traded.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - A decrease in the arms trade.
